about.p1: I'm a Generative AI Engineer based in Bengaluru, currently at WordWise Language Labs where I develop agentic AI tools and multi-source data pipelines — improving knowledge retrieval accuracy by 35% and eliminating 95% of manual intervention.
about.p2: With a B.E. in AI & Data Science from VTU, I specialize in LLM fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA), RAG architectures (GraphRAG, RAFT, CAG), and building scalable solutions using LangChain, LangGraph, and AWS.
about.p3: Passionate about computer vision, deep learning, and creating AI systems that solve problems — from surveillance intelligence to emergency response.
